manufacturerBoundary.assessment: Type 4262A supports multiple pressure ranges, pressure-unit variants and mV/V/mA electrical-output options. Hardware capability therefore does not establish the engineering unit or scaling used in the delivered CSV.

establishedFacts: a later stage switches a sensor to core-water flow
a later stage records nozzle temperature at junction-box channel 4

questions: What engineering unit do the delivered CSV values use?
Are the CSV values already scaled pressure values, or raw/transformed electrical output from the Kistler 4262A?
If a conversion was applied, what scale factor, offset and sensor configuration/variant were used?
clarificationRequests.minimumEvidenceForPromotion: A source-author/data-dictionary statement that explicitly defines the delivered CSV engineering unit and any scaling/conversion.

questions: What engineering unit do the delivered CSV values use?
What physical zero/origin/reference is used for screw position?
Are values already scaled engineering coordinates or an electrical/raw acquisition value?
clarificationRequests.minimumEvidenceForPromotion: A source-author/data-dictionary statement defining both engineering unit and position reference/origin for the delivered export.

questions: Which exact physical sensor/signal is exported as Analog Input[1]?
Is that assignment stable across all 307 delivered cycle CSVs or does it change by trial stage?
What engineering unit and scaling are used in each applicable configuration?
clarificationRequests.minimumEvidenceForPromotion: An authoritative binding from Analog Input[1] to a stable sensor/configuration and engineering unit, or an authoritative stage map that permits deterministic subset counting.

questions: For which exact cycle ranges/stages was Analog Input[2] connected to water temperature, core-water flow, nozzle temperature, or any other signal?
What engineering unit and scaling apply in each configuration?
Can the support-stage table be used as the authoritative row/cycle mapping, and if so what are the exact boundaries?
clarificationRequests.minimumEvidenceForPromotion: An authoritative stage-to-cycle mapping plus engineering unit/scaling for each configuration. A single global meaning/unit is not acceptable.

outreachDraft.subject: Clarification of PASCOE ImPure CSV sensor units and analogue-channel mapping
outreachDraft.body: We are profiling the open CC BY 4.0 ImPure Injection Molding Sensor Data (Zenodo 6913660) using aggregate-only QA. Four cavity pressure/temperature channels are source-defined, but four delivered fields remain intentionally excluded from measured-value totals. Could you confirm: (1) the engineering unit and any scaling/conversion for HydPressure[IRT/Pascoe]; (2) the engineering unit and zero/reference for ScrewPosition[IRT/Pascoe]; (3) the exact sensor, unit and whether the assignment is stable for Analog Input[1]; and (4) the stage/cycle mapping, sensor identity, units and scaling for Analog Input[2], which the trial metadata indicates was reconfigured between water-temperature, core-water-flow and nozzle-temperature measurements? A short data dictionary or mapping table is sufficient. We will keep unresolved fields non-counting until source-defined semantics are available.
